prompt: Implement shortest_path(graph, start, target) for a non-negative weighted adjacency-list graph.
tests:
from solution import shortest_path
g={'A':[('B',5),('C',1)],'B':[('D',1)],'C':[('B',1),('D',8)],'D':[],'E':[]}
assert shortest_path(g,'A','D') == 3
assert shortest_path(g,'A','A') == 0
assert shortest_path(g,'A','E') == float('inf')

prompt: Implement shortest_path(graph, start, target). Handle repeated relaxations and missing endpoints safely.
tests:
from solution import shortest_path
g={0:[(1,10),(2,1)],1:[(3,1)],2:[(1,1),(3,20)],3:[]}
assert shortest_path(g,0,3) == 3
assert shortest_path(g,9,3) == float('inf')

prompt: Implement is_balanced(text) for (), [], and {} brackets while ignoring non-bracket characters.
tests:
from solution import is_balanced
assert is_balanced('a+(b*[c-{d}])')
assert not is_balanced('([)]')
assert not is_balanced(']')
assert is_balanced('plain text')

prompt: Implement first_bracket_error(text), returning None when balanced or the zero-based index of the first invalid closing/unclosed opening bracket.
tests:
from solution import first_bracket_error
assert first_bracket_error('([])') is None
assert first_bracket_error('([)]') == 2
assert first_bracket_error('abc]') == 3
assert first_bracket_error('(()') == 0

prompt: Implement merge_intervals(intervals), merging overlapping and touching integer intervals without mutating the input.
tests:
from solution import merge_intervals
source=[[1,3],[2,6],[8,10],[15,18]]
assert merge_intervals(source) == [[1,6],[8,10],[15,18]]
assert source == [[1,3],[2,6],[8,10],[15,18]]
assert merge_intervals([[1,4],[4,5]]) == [[1,5]]
assert merge_intervals([]) == []

prompt: Implement insert_interval(intervals, new_interval) for sorted non-overlapping intervals, merging all overlaps without mutating inputs.
tests:
from solution import insert_interval
a=[[1,3],[6,9]]; b=[2,5]
assert insert_interval(a,b) == [[1,5],[6,9]]
assert a == [[1,3],[6,9]] and b == [2,5]
assert insert_interval([[1,2],[3,5],[6,7],[8,10],[12,16]],[4,8]) == [[1,2],[3,10],[12,16]]
